title: SLEEPER — converge sleeper and prove it in the world, or shrink it honestly

falsifiers.rule: no second consumer of a v2 artifact within 2 moves after P1 -> demote the contract to a note; stop calling it a spine
3 moves without an outside consequence -> STOP; report the goal as not proven, keep surfaces, write nothing new
P2 fails the blind-reader test -> shrink to deterministic resolution ladder over one document; drop all districts language
any new field or route lands before P3 completes -> revert it
a projection identity chain breaks (ladder tag changes with unchanged painting bytes) -> freeze that surface until re-proven
operator withdraws the paintings or closes the goal -> shrink to archive-only stewardship
